title: Resilient Qwen3 14B native tool validation
description: Detect whether qwen3:14b already exists on the exact OpenClaw Ollama endpoint and skip download when present. Otherwise perform observable Ollama CLI pull in a background job with heartbeat and timeout. Then validate genuine structured message.tool_calls without changing OpenClaw configuration.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$ep=Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint-v414.json';$base=(Get-Content $ep -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).baseUrl;$model='qwen3:14b';$tags=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Get -Uri ($base+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 30;$present=@($tags.models|ForEach-Object{[string]$_.name}) -contains $model;if($present){Write-Output ('V444C_057M3_PULL=SKIP_ALREADY_PRESENT model='+$model)}else{$ollama=(Get-Command ollama.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source;$job=Start-Job -ScriptBlock {param($exe,$m,$hostUrl);$env:OLLAMA_HOST=$hostUrl;& $exe pull $m 2>&1|ForEach-Object{$_};$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;Write-Output ('__OLLAMA_EXIT_CODE__='+$ec);if($ec -ne 0){exit $ec}} -ArgumentList $ollama,$model,$base;$deadline=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(15);$seen=0;try{while($job.State -in @('NotStarted','Running')){if((Get-Date) -ge $deadline){Stop-Job $job -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;throw '057M3_PULL_TIMEOUT_15M'};Start-Sleep -Seconds 15;$out=@(Receive-Job $job -Keep -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue);if($out.Count -gt $seen){$new=@($out[$seen..($out.Count-1)]);$seen=$out.Count;$tail=($new|Select-Object -Last 3|ForEach-Object{[string]$_}) -join ' ';Write-Output ('V444C_057M3_HEARTBEAT='+((Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss'))+' '+$tail)}else{Write-Output ('V444C_057M3_HEARTBEAT='+((Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss'))+' waiting')}};$all=@(Receive-Job $job -Keep -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue);$marker=@($all|ForEach-Object{[string]$_}|Where-Object{$_ -like '__OLLAMA_EXIT_CODE__=*'}|Select-Object -Last 1);if($marker.Count -lt 1){throw ('057M3_PULL_JOB_NO_EXIT_MARKER state='+$job.State)};$ec=[int](($marker[0] -split '=',2)[1]);if($ec -ne 0){throw ('057M3_PULL_EXIT_'+$ec)};if($job.State -ne 'Completed'){throw ('057M3_PULL_JOB_STATE_'+$job.State)};Write-Output 'V444C_057M3_PULL_STATUS=SUCCESS'}finally{Remove-Job $job -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}};$tags2=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Get -Uri ($base+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 30;$present2=@($tags2.models|ForEach-Object{[string]$_.name}) -contains $model;if(-not $present2){throw '057M3_MODEL_NOT_PRESENT_AFTER_PULL'};$show=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/show') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body (@{model=$model}|ConvertTo-Json) -TimeoutSec 60;$caps=@($show.capabilities);$supportsTools=($caps -contains 'tools');$tool=@{type='function';function=@{name='write_probe';description='Create a probe file';parameters=@{type='object';properties=@{path=@{type='string'};content=@{type='string'}};required=@('path','content')}}};$body=@{model=$model;stream=$false;messages=@(@{role='system';content='You are a tool-using agent. When a matching tool is available, call it. Do not answer with JSON, XML, markdown, or prose instead of a tool call.'},@{role='user';content='Call write_probe exactly once with path C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/qwen3-native-tool-probe.txt and content QWEN3_NATIVE_TOOL_OK.'});tools=@($tool);options=@{temperature=0}}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30;$resp=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/chat') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 600;$msg=$resp.message;$props=if($null -ne $msg){@($msg.PSObject.Properties.Name)}else{@()};$tc=@();if($null -ne $msg -and ($props -contains 'tool_calls') -and $null -ne $msg.tool_calls){$tc=@($msg.tool_calls)};$calls=@($tc|ForEach-Object{[pscustomobject]@{name=[string]$_.function.name;arguments=$_.function.arguments}});$artifact=Join-Path $root 'qwen3-14b-native-tool-validation-v444c.json';[pscustomobject]@{testedAt=(Get-Date).ToString('o');endpoint=$base;model=$model;modelPresent=$present2;capabilities=$caps;supportsTools=$supportsTools;messageProperties=$props;toolCallCount=$tc.Count;structured=($tc.Count -gt 0);toolCalls=$calls}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20|Set-Content $artifact -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output ('V444C_057M3_CAPS='+($caps -join ','));Write-Output ('V444C_057M3_MESSAGE_PROPS='+($props -join ','));Write-Output ('V444C_057M3_TOOL_CALL_COUNT='+$tc.Count);foreach($c in $calls){Write-Output ('V444C_057M3_TOOL_CALL='+$c.name+' args='+($c.arguments|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 10))};Write-Output ('V444C_057M3_STRUCTURED='+($tc.Count -gt 0));Write-Output ('V444C_057M3_ARTIFACT='+$artifact)
